{{MissingInfo|1|java}} [[File:Berrybaker kids.png|thumb|250px|The Berrybaker kids]] The '''Berrybaker kids''' (Japanese: '''トラヤ兄妹''' ''Toraya siblings'') are [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY026|A Battle by Any Other Name!]]''. They competed in the [[Poké Puff Contest]] with their {{p|Makuhita}}. At the end of the preliminary round, it was revealed that they had advanced to the final round, which made them and their Makuhita very excited. In the final round, they made Japanese-style [[Poké Puff]]s. When the final results were announced, they were declared the winners of the competition. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Berrybaker kids |pkmn=Makuhita |type1=Fighting |img=Berrybaker kids Makuhita.png |epnum=XY026 |epname=A Battle by Any Other Name! |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Makuhita}} is the Berrybaker kids' only known Pokémon. It helped them out in making [[Poké Puff]]s during the [[Poké Puff Contest]], and its assistance helped them get through the preliminary round. In the final round, Makuhita and its Trainers made a Japanese-style Poké Puff and they were announced to be the winners of the competition.
